name: Minamoto Minamo
source:
The protagonist's younger sister. She is always in high spirits, cannot help but doing whatever comes to her mind, the personification of being active. With a strong push and pressure, whenever there is a gap, she immediately acts recklessly, forcing everyone to be on their toes, but perhaps due to her straightforward personality, strangely, she is impossible to hate, and Natsumi thinks of her as her real sister.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.lumpofsugar.co.jp/product/haruyome/images/character/character005.png]official website[/url]]
